Therapy for Black Girls: Podcast centered around mental wellness for Black women. https://therapyforblackgirls.com/podcast/

Counseling Alliance of VA: Culturally based trauma supportive services and culturally responsive counseling services. https://www.cavahelps.com/

Central Virginia Clinicians of Color Network: Temporary NON-CRISIS emotional support by phone for adult people of color on Wednesdays 5-8pm during COVID-19 outbreak. Call during this time and/or leave your name, phone, and email to receive a call back. If demand exceeds available resources, our team will make every effort to connect you with appropriate care. https://cvccn.org/

Trans Lifeline: A non-profit hotline staffed by transgender volunteers for people who are experiencing difficulty or crisis. https://translifeline.org/

Sister Circle Presents...10 Self-Care Tips for Black Women: Looking to engage in some self-care? Here's 10 ways you can! https://static1.squarespace.com/static/50a50853e4b013b04b89ffc5/t/5ed80f43b6b8fc226c25e275/1591218015612/2020-06+Sister+Circle+Self-Care+Tips.pdf

Tool Kits & Resources from the Black Emotional and Mental Health Collective: Explore different ways that you can care for your emotional and mental health. https://www.beam.community/tool-kits-education
